Name: Seasonal Anime Sprite - Abigail
Author: MrKiDD0
Description:
I always like Ohodavi's portrait but unfortunately I think Abigail portrait doesn't match her sprite. So I just redesign her sprite to satisfy my feeling. Hope you guys can enjoy it too with/without the portrait mods

I design this with nose in mind, so you guys might like it more than the no nose option ( Can be configured inside Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic )

[b][u]Installations
[/u][/b]
1. Make sure to have SMAPI and content patcher
2. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] and extract it in mods folder
3. Download my mod﻿, extract it and simply replace the files inside [b][CP] Seasonal Cute Characters[/b]
[b]   [i] Path folder:[/i] [/b][i]...\Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Seasonal Cute Characters\[/i]

[u][b]Optional[/b][/u]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22876]Anime Seasonal Outfits[/url][b] - [/b]not required, it just a portrait mod that I use with the sprite
﻿
